scenarios.name: Hero Section Display
scenarios.description: Verify that the hero section displays the product name (MirDB), logo, value proposition, and call-to-action buttons correctly

steps.description: Navigate to the MirDB landing page URL
steps.context: User accesses the homepage for the first time

steps.description: Check that 'MirDB' is prominently displayed with the logo in the hero section
steps.context: REQ-1: Display product name with logo prominently

steps.description: Confirm the tagline 'A Persistent Key-Value Store with Memcached Protocol' is visible
steps.context: REQ-2: Present the core value proposition

steps.description: Check that primary and secondary call-to-action buttons are present and visible
steps.context: REQ-8: Feature a call-to-action button

test_cases.input: Load landing page and inspect hero section
test_cases.expected: Product name 'MirDB' is displayed prominently with h1 or equivalent styling

test_cases.input: Check for logo element in hero section
test_cases.expected: Logo image is present and renders correctly (assets/logo.gif or equivalent)

test_cases.input: Inspect hero section for tagline text
test_cases.expected: Text containing 'Persistent Key-Value Store' and 'Memcached Protocol' is visible
A button with text like 'Get Started' or 'View on GitHub' is visible and clickable
A secondary button with text like 'Learn More' is visible
